declaration_order: Before calculating any EXEC37 timing distribution; manifests/ROOT existence and hashes already verified read-only
observable: V2 same_end_T1_minus_T2, CH1 low cluster minus CH5 high cluster; both finite crossings required
normalization: Report raw width and width/sqrt(2); equal independent group contributions is the test-beam assumption, not verified

bootstrap.unit: generated event, all IDs 0..1999; preserve missing crossings before resampling
bootstrap.SE: sample standard deviation ddof=1, plus percentile intervals

validity: Apply unchanged EXEC35 width validity independently for robust/Gaussian; do not alter the EXEC36 historical sanity guard. EXEC37 C1 is a new centre-only criterion, not retroactive experimental calibration.

C1.pass: VALID primary width and point estimate <=88.4 ps
C1.fail: VALID primary width and point estimate >88.4 ps; under the task criterion report an unidentified residual light deficit
C1.invalid: Invalid primary width yields INVALID, not a physical pass/fail
C1.uncertainty: Report bootstrap SE, interval and crossing fraction; do not change the point-estimate rule after results

C2.numerator: EXEC36 EJ204_xp0 V2, matching end, baseline pulse and threshold, N=10000
C2.denominator: D0 or D3 matching-end normalized core width, N=2000
C2.benchmark_expression: sqrt(1173.34/397.15); retain exact original EXEC29 manifest yields too
C2.decision: No PASS/FAIL; report ratio, difference and percentage departure from benchmark
C2.uncertainty: Delta-method ratio SE with zero cross-run covariance approximation, explicitly not established independence; shared seeds and different sample sizes prevent claiming calibrated independent errors

C3.uncertainty: Transform the existing event-bootstrap width replicas only when inside the real domain; report valid-domain fraction and conditional SE/percentile interval; no test-beam uncertainty was supplied
C3.interpretation: Indirect quadrature-equivalent residual, not measured electronics/SPTR. Quantile widths are not variances; quadrature is an additional modelling assumption.

scope: Only centre x=0 and N=2000 END-only; no position scan; sensor/PDE, time reference and quantization discrepancies persist. Mylar is a legacy name for physical Vikuiti 3M ESR, not a hardware discrepancy.
